plan.schema: schema.json freezes baseline frontend row/column names; missing/duplicate coordinates, missing required matrices, unknown literal rows/columns and incomplete panels fail

candidate.policy: Strict checkpoint only; exact current operator with accepted historical direct/SGS action; no drift cutoff, positive finite ratios and exact compatible coordinates required
candidate.memory: Only existing persistent Fast canonical-products reservation, no budget or route change; Low and saved-FE remain cold
candidate.fallback: Per component/original RHS half-cap speculative PCG then one cold retry with remainder; late certificate failure retains ledger; essential failures propagate

scope.certificate: Native independently recomputed pass at unchanged tolerances; continuous diagnostics may differ
scope.exact: Sample row IDs/status, rank/omission, separation/singletons, missingness, success/certificate decisions, outer counts, strict accept/resume and existing fallback routes; fixed-worker same-arm results exact
scope.excluded: Build identity,timing,resource observations,new preconditioner diagnostics and scoped strict reduced work

gate.target: dense-4m total native ratio<=0.95 in both pairs at4and16workers
gate.reuse: Actual accepted cache consumed at strict checkpoint
gate.science: All pre-fit focused witnesses; all pair/cross-worker science and protected decisions; all fixed-worker repeats
gate.failure: Stop dependent stage on failed prerequisite. Retain all attempted fits, no resampling/retuning. No production integration or ordinary reuse on failed/inconclusive gate

plan.review: Independent Astra design approved existing Fast reservation; source and focused-test evidence review before fits
limitations: SCC diagnostic timing, not Mac qualification
No whole-fit gain established before panel

prerequisite_commands.source: stable task-only candidate; one focused qualification run after development checks
commands: cargo test -p fereg-oracle --profile ci --test seeded_dense_ppml_differential --test ppml
prerequisite_commands.kind: Focused scientific/lifecycle tests before timing, separate from the 100 native estimation calls in the fit harness

plan.trace_completeness: Source-backed initialized and target prepared_irls_start plus complete 1..ic target outer events, terminal accepted strict_result or documented joint-final variant, mandatory fields per recognized phase

fit.py.source:
"""One frozen bounded strict-only complete-fit discovery on retained synthetic inputs."""
import csv, hashlib, json, os, socket, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(os.environ['RUN_ROOT'])
REF=Path('/projectnb/welfgr/fereg/runs/20261012T020354Z-optimized-d9865e57')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'baseline/bench'))
import campaign
from run import write_configuration,read_metadata
from analyze import compare_pair,summarize,read_process_trace

def sha(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
  for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1<<20),b''): h.update(chunk)
 return h.hexdigest()
def put(name,value): campaign.write_json(ROOT/name,value)
def manifest(name):
 for line in (ROOT/name).read_text().splitlines():
  digest,rel=line.split(maxsplit=1)
  assert sha(ROOT/rel.strip())==digest,rel

manifest('SHA256SUMS');manifest('plugin.sha256')
assert (ROOT/'SOURCE_REVIEW_PASSED').is_file()
assert (ROOT/'FOCUSED_CHECKS_PASSED').is_file()
external={'smoke/data/ppml-akm-baseline-n1200.dta':'5729abe1b4c0cda599a1eba7c0d32844f58634601508ecf3c562550eb043d2c1','task-2/data/warm.dta':'4f3249f81c9b1cbf65d0a66ead31dea7acb6378165cd9f5cdd5503487e6d2876','environment/command-clock.plugin':'9e99876289df144aa2f465410b442fe28e4c8adc2ad3ee17cb03ea4a61a88684'}
for path,digest in external.items(): assert sha(REF/path)==digest
put('external-inputs.json',external)
inputs=[('akm-1m',2,'ppml-akm-baseline-n1000000','0c873dcd5e8f2468115a44712d20b21492ca88210d1a97194ab244441dfcdfd8'),('dense-1m',3,'ppml-two-dense-n1000000','1b88b707541f271490125709a902e0f85889dd17ed96982a8a276dabec06b88c'),('dense-4m',2,'ppml-two-dense-n4000000','e409f1f88843039993712e5e276f95c5fbe306ef95d2e7b0b0d67ac579cface0'),('sparse-1m',3,'ppml-two-sparse-n1000000','8cb82127870859b2562f4677c773321387bd8e70f4aaac19624b516ea1eb7303')]
paths={}
for label,task,name,digest in inputs:
 path=REF/f'task-{task}/data/{name}.dta'
 assert sha(path)==digest
 paths[label]=str(path)
put('inputs.json',[dict(label=l,sha256=h) for l,_,_,h in inputs])
cpus=campaign.physical_cpus()
assert len(cpus)==int(os.environ['NSLOTS'])==28
put('environment.json',dict(host=socket.gethostname(),job=os.environ['JOB_ID'],cpus=cpus,lscpu=subprocess.check_output(['lscpu'],text=True),topology=subprocess.check_output(['lscpu','-e=CPU,CORE,SOCKET,NODE,ONLINE'],text=True)))
records=[]
def fit(label,path,workers,arm,pair,limit):
 out=ROOT/'output'/f'{label}-t{workers}-p{pair}-{arm}'
 out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
 source=ROOT/arm
 settings=dict(source=source,refs=REF/'environment/references',output=out,dataset=path,warm=REF/'task-2/data/warm.dta',arm='fereg',model='ppml',k=16,effects=2,threads=workers,save_fe=0,vce='robust',tolerance='',clock_plugin=REF/'environment/command-clock.plugin')
 write_configuration(out,settings)
 os.environ.update(CAMPAIGN_SOURCE=str(source),FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE='1',FEREG_PHASE_TIMING='1',FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE_FILE=str(out/'solver-trace.txt'))
 command=out/'command.do';command.write_text(f'do "{ROOT}/campaign.do" "{out}/config.do"\n')
 obs=campaign.execute(['stata-mp','-b','do',str(command)],out,cpus[:workers],limit)
 meta=read_metadata(out/'metadata.tsv') if (out/'metadata.tsv').exists() else {}
 logs='\n'.join(p.read_text(errors='replace') for p in out.glob('*.log'))
 rec=dict(label=label,workers=workers,arm=arm,pair=pair,observation=obs,metadata=meta,tables={p.stem:list(csv.DictReader(p.open())) for p in out.glob('*.csv') if p.name!='rows.csv'},rows_sha256=sha(out/'rows.csv') if (out/'rows.csv').exists() else None,trace=read_process_trace(out/'process.log'),output=str(out.relative_to(ROOT)))
 records.append(rec);put('records.json',records)
 print(label,workers,pair,arm,obs['status'],meta.get('rc'),flush=True)
 assert obs['status']=='ok' and obs['process_rc']==0 and meta.get('rc')=='0' and meta.get('complete')=='1'
 assert 'CAMPAIGN_COMPLETE rc=0' in logs
 assert rec['trace'] and rec['rows_sha256']
 return rec

smoke_start=time.monotonic()
smoke=REF/'smoke/data/ppml-akm-baseline-n1200.dta'
if sys.argv[1:]==['--validated-smoke']:
 # One operational log-reader repair before any target attempt, never a fit retry.
 manifest('SMOKE_REPAIR_SHA256SUMS')
 assert not (ROOT/'smoke.json').exists() and not (ROOT/'summary.json').exists()
 original=json.loads((ROOT/'records-smoke-original.json').read_text())
 assert json.loads((ROOT/'records.json').read_text())==original
 assert [(r['label'],r['workers'],r['pair'],r['arm']) for r in original]==[('smoke',1,0,'baseline'),('smoke',1,0,'candidate')]
 assert {p.name for p in (ROOT/'output').iterdir()}=={'smoke-t1-p0-baseline','smoke-t1-p0-candidate'}
 accounting=dict(line.split(maxsplit=1) for line in (ROOT/'accounting-panel-smoke.txt').read_text().splitlines() if len(line.split(maxsplit=1))==2)
 assert accounting['jobnumber'].strip()=='8051353' and accounting['failed'].strip()=='0'
 assert accounting['exit_status'].strip()=='1' and float(accounting['ru_wallclock'])<=60
 for rec in original:
  out=ROOT/rec['output']
  assert rec['observation']['status']=='ok' and rec['observation']['process_rc']==0 and rec['observation']['wall_seconds']<=30
  assert rec['metadata']==read_metadata(out/'metadata.tsv') and rec['metadata']['rc']=='0' and rec['metadata']['complete']=='1'
  assert rec['tables']=={p.stem:list(csv.DictReader(p.open())) for p in out.glob('*.csv') if p.name!='rows.csv'}
  assert rec['rows_sha256']==sha(out/'rows.csv')
  assert 'CAMPAIGN_COMPLETE rc=0' in (out/'command.log').read_text()
  rec['trace']=read_process_trace(out/'process.log')
 records.extend(original);a,b=records
 smoke_elapsed=float(accounting['ru_wallclock'])
else:
 assert not sys.argv[1:]
 a=fit('smoke',str(smoke),1,'baseline',0,30)
 b=fit('smoke',str(smoke),1,'candidate',0,min(30,60-(time.monotonic()-smoke_start)))
 smoke_elapsed=time.monotonic()-smoke_start
smoke_science=compare_pair(a,b)
put('smoke.json',dict(passed=True,science=smoke_science,target_fits=2,initialization_fits=2,elapsed_seconds=smoke_elapsed,reused_completed_fits=bool(sys.argv[1:])))
put('records.json',records)
assert smoke_elapsed<=60
panel_start=time.monotonic()
for label,_,_,_ in inputs:
 for workers in [1,4,16]:
  for pair,arms in enumerate([['baseline','candidate'],['candidate','baseline']]):
   observations={}
   for arm in arms:
    remaining=2400-(time.monotonic()-panel_start)
    assert remaining>0,'panel budget exhausted'
    observations[arm]=fit(label,paths[label],workers,arm,pair,min(120,remaining))
   compare_pair(observations['baseline'],observations['candidate'])
elapsed=time.monotonic()-panel_start
assert elapsed<=2400
summary=summarize([r for r in records if r['label']!='smoke'])
summary.update(panel_executed=True,elapsed_seconds=elapsed,target_fits=48,initialization_fits=48,smoke_native_calls=4,total_native_estimation_calls=100)
put('summary.json',summary)
manifest('SHA256SUMS');manifest('plugin.sha256')
for path,digest in external.items(): assert sha(REF/path)==digest
for label,_,_,digest in inputs: assert sha(paths[label])==digest
(ROOT/'PANEL_COMPLETE').write_text('H9_STRICT_PANEL_COMPLETE rc=0\n')

campaign.do.source:
version 19.0
clear all
set more off
set varabbrev off
set linesize 255
args configuration
include `"`configuration'"'
local processors = min(`threads', 4, c(processors_lic), c(processors_mach))
set processors `processors'
sysdir set PLUS `"`refs'"'
sysdir set PERSONAL `"`output'"'
capture adopath - SITE
capture adopath - "."
adopath ++ `"`refs'"'
adopath ++ `"`source'/stata"'
adopath ++ `"`source'/dist"'
if "`arm'" == "fereg" {
    quietly findfile fereg_linux.plugin
    assert `"`r(fn)'"' == `"`source'/dist/fereg_linux.plugin"'
}
local xvars
forvalues j=1/`k' {
    local xvars `xvars' x`j'
}
local absorb
forvalues j=1/`effects' {
    local term g`j'
    if `save_fe' local term saved`j'=g`j'
    local absorb `absorb' `term'
}
local inference vce(`vce')
if "`vce'" == "iid" local inference vce(unadjusted)
if "`vce'" == "cluster" local inference vce(cluster cluster)
local command `arm'
if "`arm'" == "fereg" & "`model'" == "ppml" local command feppml
local options
if "`arm'" == "fereg" local options threads(`threads')
if "`tolerance'" != "" local options `options' tolerance(`tolerance')
* Initialization uses a separate small input and is excluded from timing.
quietly use `"`warm'"', clear
capture noisily quietly `command' y `xvars', absorb(g1) `inference' `options'
local init_rc = _rc
if `init_rc' exit `init_rc', clear
quietly use `"`dataset'"', clear
program _campaign_clock, plugin using(`"`clock_plugin'"')
tempname command_seconds resolution
scalar `command_seconds' = .
scalar `resolution' = .
display "CAMPAIGN_READY"
file open ready using `"`output'/READY"', write text replace
file write ready "ready" _n
file close ready
plugin call _campaign_clock, start
capture noisily quietly `command' y `xvars', absorb(`absorb') `inference' `options'
local rc = _rc
plugin call _campaign_clock, stop `command_seconds' `resolution'
file open done using `"`output'/DONE"', write text replace
file write done "done" _n
file close done
tempname meta
file open `meta' using `"`output'/metadata.tsv"', write text replace
file write `meta' "rc" _tab "`rc'" _n
file write `meta' "seconds" _tab %24.17g (scalar(`command_seconds')) _n
file write `meta' "clock_resolution" _tab %24.17g (scalar(`resolution')) _n
file write `meta' "processors" _tab "`processors'" _n
file write `meta' "processors_licensed" _tab %24.17g (c(processors_lic)) _n
if !`rc' {
    if "`arm'" == "fereg" {
        if "`model'" == "ols" {
            local row = 18
            foreach phase in preflight input native total {
                file write `meta' "`phase'_seconds" _tab %24.17g (el(e(fereg_runtime),`row',2)) _n
                local ++row
            }
        }
        else {
            file write `meta' "total_seconds" _tab %24.17g (el(e(feppml_runtime),1,1)) _n
            local phases : rownames e(feppml_runtime)
            forvalues row=28/40 {
                local phase : word `row' of `phases'
                file write `meta' "`phase'" _tab %24.17g (el(e(feppml_runtime),`row',1)) _n
            }
        }
    }
    foreach scalar in ic iterations feppml_iterations feppml_converged N rank df_a df_m df_r df_resid N_clust num_singletons separated converged rss ll deviance fereg_threads feppml_threads {
        capture local value = e(`scalar')
        if !_rc file write `meta' "`scalar'" _tab %24.17g (`value') _n
    }
    tempname coefficients covariance
    matrix `coefficients' = e(b)
    matrix `covariance' = e(V)
    _ms_omit_info e(b)
    tempname omitted
    matrix `omitted' = r(omit)
    local slope_omissions = 0
    local names : colnames e(b)
    forvalues j=1/`=colsof(e(b))' {
        local name : word `j' of `names'
        if !inlist("`name'", "_cons", "o._cons") local slope_omissions = `slope_omissions' + el(`omitted',1,`j')
    }
    file write `meta' "slope_omissions" _tab "`slope_omissions'" _n
    file write `meta' "finite_slope_rank" _tab "`k'" _n
    file write `meta' "covariance_policy" _tab "stock-`model'-`vce'" _n
    mata: b=st_matrix("`coefficients'"); V=st_matrix("`covariance'"); stripe=st_matrixcolstripe("`coefficients'"); f=fopen(`"`output'/coefficients.csv"', "w"); fput(f,"name,value"); for(i=1;i<=cols(b);i++) fput(f,sprintf("%s,%24.17g",stripe[i,2],b[i])); fclose(f); f=fopen(`"`output'/covariance.csv"',"w"); fput(f,"row,column,value"); for(i=1;i<=rows(V);i++) for(j=1;j<=cols(V);j++) fput(f,sprintf("%s,%s,%24.17g",stripe[i,2],stripe[j,2],V[i,j])); fclose(f)
    foreach name in status fit dof fe cluster subset separation inference drop_counts separation_sequence certificate solver runtime {
        mata: M=st_matrix("e(feppml_`name')"); rs=st_matrixrowstripe("e(feppml_`name')"); cs=st_matrixcolstripe("e(feppml_`name')"); f=fopen(`"`output'/`name'.csv"',"w"); fput(f,"row,column,value"); for(i=1;i<=rows(M);i++) for(j=1;j<=cols(M);j++) fput(f,sprintf("%s,%s,%24.17g",rs[i,2],cs[j,2],M[i,j])); fclose(f)
    }
    quietly generate byte retained = e(sample)
    if `save_fe' {
        quietly generate double fitted = 0
        forvalues j=1/`k' {
            quietly replace fitted = fitted + _b[x`j']*x`j' if retained
        }
        capture local constant = _b[_cons]
        if !_rc quietly replace fitted = fitted + `constant' if retained
        forvalues j=1/`effects' {
            quietly replace fitted = fitted + saved`j' if retained
        }
        if "`model'" == "ppml" quietly replace fitted = exp(fitted) if retained
        local outvars obs_id retained fitted saved*
    }
    else local outvars obs_id retained
    preserve
    quietly keep `outvars'
    format obs_id %12.0f
    capture format fitted saved* %24.17g
    quietly export delimited using `"`output'/rows.csv"', replace datafmt
    restore
}
file write `meta' "complete" _tab "1" _n
file close `meta'
display "CAMPAIGN_COMPLETE rc=`rc'"
exit `rc', clear

import hashlib,json,os,signal,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
commands=[('canonical',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','fereg-core','--profile','ci','--lib','ols::canonical_products::','--','--test-threads=1']),('h9-fullfit-alone',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','fereg-core','--profile','ci','--lib','h9_complete_ppml_known_optimum_hits_and_matches_cold','--','--test-threads=1']),('ppml',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','fereg-core','--profile','ci','--lib','ppml::','--','--test-threads=1']),('session',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','fereg-core','--profile','ci','--lib','ols::linear_session::','--','--test-threads=1']),('oracle',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','fereg-oracle','--profile','ci','--test','seeded_dense_ppml_differential','--test','ppml'])]
env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(root/'cargo'),CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='4',RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN='1.85.1')
results=[];start=time.monotonic()
for name,command in commands:
 remaining=1800-(time.monotonic()-start);assert remaining>0
 begin=time.monotonic()
 with (root/f'{name}-mac.log').open('w') as log:
  p=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root/'candidate',env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
  try: code=p.wait(timeout=remaining)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
   os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
   try:p.wait(timeout=10)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait()
   code=124
 text=(root/f'{name}-mac.log').read_text()
 results.append(dict(name=name,command=command,exit_code=code,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-begin,result_lines=[l for l in text.splitlines() if l.startswith('test result:')],log_sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()))
 (root/'mac-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(name,code,results[-1]['result_lines'],flush=True)
 if code:raise SystemExit(code)

"""One frozen bounded strict-only complete-fit discovery on retained synthetic inputs."""
import csv, hashlib, json, os, socket, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(os.environ['RUN_ROOT'])
REF=Path('/projectnb/welfgr/fereg/runs/20261012T020354Z-optimized-d9865e57')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'baseline/bench'))
import campaign
from run import write_configuration,read_metadata
from analyze import compare_pair,summarize

def sha(path):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
  for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1<<20),b''): h.update(chunk)
 return h.hexdigest()
def put(name,value): campaign.write_json(ROOT/name,value)
def manifest(name):
 for line in (ROOT/name).read_text().splitlines():
  digest,rel=line.split(maxsplit=1)
  assert sha(ROOT/rel.strip())==digest,rel

manifest('SHA256SUMS');manifest('plugin.sha256')
assert (ROOT/'SOURCE_REVIEW_PASSED').is_file()
assert (ROOT/'FOCUSED_CHECKS_PASSED').is_file()
external={'smoke/data/ppml-akm-baseline-n1200.dta':'5729abe1b4c0cda599a1eba7c0d32844f58634601508ecf3c562550eb043d2c1','task-2/data/warm.dta':'4f3249f81c9b1cbf65d0a66ead31dea7acb6378165cd9f5cdd5503487e6d2876','environment/command-clock.plugin':'9e99876289df144aa2f465410b442fe28e4c8adc2ad3ee17cb03ea4a61a88684'}
for path,digest in external.items(): assert sha(REF/path)==digest
put('external-inputs.json',external)
inputs=[('akm-1m',2,'ppml-akm-baseline-n1000000','0c873dcd5e8f2468115a44712d20b21492ca88210d1a97194ab244441dfcdfd8'),('dense-1m',3,'ppml-two-dense-n1000000','1b88b707541f271490125709a902e0f85889dd17ed96982a8a276dabec06b88c'),('dense-4m',2,'ppml-two-dense-n4000000','e409f1f88843039993712e5e276f95c5fbe306ef95d2e7b0b0d67ac579cface0'),('sparse-1m',3,'ppml-two-sparse-n1000000','8cb82127870859b2562f4677c773321387bd8e70f4aaac19624b516ea1eb7303')]
paths={}
for label,task,name,digest in inputs:
 path=REF/f'task-{task}/data/{name}.dta'
 assert sha(path)==digest
 paths[label]=str(path)
put('inputs.json',[dict(label=l,sha256=h) for l,_,_,h in inputs])
cpus=campaign.physical_cpus()
assert len(cpus)==int(os.environ['NSLOTS'])==28
put('environment.json',dict(host=socket.gethostname(),job=os.environ['JOB_ID'],cpus=cpus,lscpu=subprocess.check_output(['lscpu'],text=True),topology=subprocess.check_output(['lscpu','-e=CPU,CORE,SOCKET,NODE,ONLINE'],text=True)))
records=[]
def fit(label,path,workers,arm,pair,limit):
 out=ROOT/'output'/f'{label}-t{workers}-p{pair}-{arm}'
 out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
 source=ROOT/arm
 settings=dict(source=source,refs=REF/'environment/references',output=out,dataset=path,warm=REF/'task-2/data/warm.dta',arm='fereg',model='ppml',k=16,effects=2,threads=workers,save_fe=0,vce='robust',tolerance='',clock_plugin=REF/'environment/command-clock.plugin')
 write_configuration(out,settings)
 os.environ.update(CAMPAIGN_SOURCE=str(source),FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE='1',FEREG_PHASE_TIMING='1',FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE_FILE=str(out/'solver-trace.txt'))
 command=out/'command.do';command.write_text(f'do "{ROOT}/campaign.do" "{out}/config.do"\n')
 obs=campaign.execute(['stata-mp','-b','do',str(command)],out,cpus[:workers],limit)
 meta=read_metadata(out/'metadata.tsv') if (out/'metadata.tsv').exists() else {}
 logs='\n'.join(p.read_text(errors='replace') for p in out.glob('*.log'))
 rec=dict(label=label,workers=workers,arm=arm,pair=pair,observation=obs,metadata=meta,tables={p.stem:list(csv.DictReader(p.open())) for p in out.glob('*.csv') if p.name!='rows.csv'},rows_sha256=sha(out/'rows.csv') if (out/'rows.csv').exists() else None,trace=(out/'solver-trace.txt').read_text().splitlines() if (out/'solver-trace.txt').exists() else [],output=str(out.relative_to(ROOT)))
 records.append(rec);put('records.json',records)
 print(label,workers,pair,arm,obs['status'],meta.get('rc'),flush=True)
 assert obs['status']=='ok' and obs['process_rc']==0 and meta.get('rc')=='0' and meta.get('complete')=='1'
 assert 'CAMPAIGN_COMPLETE rc=0' in logs
 assert rec['trace'] and rec['rows_sha256']
 return rec

smoke_start=time.monotonic()
smoke=REF/'smoke/data/ppml-akm-baseline-n1200.dta'
a=fit('smoke',str(smoke),1,'baseline',0,30)
b=fit('smoke',str(smoke),1,'candidate',0,min(30,60-(time.monotonic()-smoke_start)))
smoke_science=compare_pair(a,b)
put('smoke.json',dict(passed=True,science=smoke_science,target_fits=2,initialization_fits=2,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-smoke_start))
assert time.monotonic()-smoke_start<=60
panel_start=time.monotonic()
for label,_,_,_ in inputs:
 for workers in [1,4,16]:
  for pair,arms in enumerate([['baseline','candidate'],['candidate','baseline']]):
   observations={}
   for arm in arms:
    remaining=2400-(time.monotonic()-panel_start)
    assert remaining>0,'panel budget exhausted'
    observations[arm]=fit(label,paths[label],workers,arm,pair,min(120,remaining))
   compare_pair(observations['baseline'],observations['candidate'])
elapsed=time.monotonic()-panel_start
assert elapsed<=2400
summary=summarize([r for r in records if r['label']!='smoke'])
summary.update(panel_executed=True,elapsed_seconds=elapsed,target_fits=48,initialization_fits=48,smoke_native_calls=4,total_native_estimation_calls=100)
put('summary.json',summary)
manifest('SHA256SUMS');manifest('plugin.sha256')
for path,digest in external.items(): assert sha(REF/path)==digest
for label,_,_,digest in inputs: assert sha(paths[label])==digest
(ROOT/'PANEL_COMPLETE').write_text('H9_STRICT_PANEL_COMPLETE rc=0\n')
